title: Early clarinet favorites heard in the street
summary: George says he thought all street clarinetists were good, naming George Baquet, Charlie McCurdy and Big Eye Louis.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Yeah, I should've seen her. I was wondering about clarinet players again, here to change the subject a little bit. Some of the very first you heard and who were your favorites when you were a boy that you followed in the street? It inspired you. You say you wanted to take up clarinet. Who was the first one you thought was so good that you liked the instrument?

Well Bill, I tell you, in my early days I thought they all were good, those I heard on the street. I know they all couldn't have been as good as I thought they were, but I heard a man like George Bakke, also Charlie McCurtis, T.O. and there was Big I, Louis. Big I, Louis.
